references.text: Elisur, son of Shedeur, is again mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Reuben during the camp setup.
Elisur, son of Shedeur, brings his offering as the leader of the tribe of Reuben at the dedication of the altar.
Elisur, son of Shedeur, leads the camp of Reuben when they break camp from Sinai.
Reuben was Jacob's firstborn son, and his tribe is mentioned first among the tribes of Israel.
The sons of Reuben are mentioned as the first among Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt.
